quote: I get a an epic shard about every 30-40 wands I craft
notes: First-person informal December 2022 report of an 'epic shard' about once per 30–40 blue crafted wands disenchanted, using rank-one gathered bark. This is a remembered approximate crafting frequency, NOT an enumerated completed-cast count, observed hits or an actual 0..N histogram; no total sample size. Source names neither exact wand item ID nor the epic shard material ID (200113 Resonant Crystal is discussed nearby, not linked by the author). Do not infer a specific Enchanted Writhebark Wand input ID, output rank, drop probability 1/30–1/40, per-cast expectation, gear variant, skill/spec/build or modern Retail applicability. HELD original historical anecdote as sourceKind reference only; no baseline admission.
